description: Every page load by a signed-out visitor asks GET /api/auth/me for the current user and the API answers 401, which the browser reports as a failed request (and a red line in the developer console). Probe the session without an error response, for example an endpoint that answers 200 with an anonymous user.
Same 401 from GET /api/auth/me for a signed-out visitor on the sign-in page.
Same 401 from GET /api/auth/me for a signed-out visitor on the email confirmation page.
Same 401 from GET /api/auth/me for a signed-out visitor on the contact confirmation page.
Same 401 from GET /api/auth/me on the access-denied page when no session exists (the header probes the session).

In WebKit, :focus-visible does not match the date field (input#story-date) when it is reached with Tab (focus is on it, :focus matches), so the global focus outline from components.scss never applies and the field shows no outline or box-shadow. Chromium and Firefox apply it. Style the date field with :focus-within or :focus as well.
